top_reviews.title: Fit perfectly and the orthotics help my knees sooooo much!
top_reviews.text: Liked everything about them...just need more styles and colors!

top_reviews.title: Warm and lovely
top_reviews.text: Love love love these, comfortable and warm.  At first they are snug because of the fluff inside the shoe but they loosen up same with putting your foot inside.  I bought a pair last year and they lasted all year, rebought because I loved them so much

top_reviews.title: Like waterproof Uggs!
top_reviews.text: Wore these on an almost 3 week europe trip to Germany/Austria/Switzerland. Not only was I walking in rain and through puddles but in Switzerland also snow. Some if it pretty deep and my feet stayed dry and warm. I did wear some thick wool socks under as they aren’t as warm as the normal native chamonix but these were perfect for what I wanted to wear with leggings and skinny jeans while in Europe. Wore them on the plane and every day on the trip.
